chunks: Regarding a man who hires an animal to a known place and then the animal is lost, he said: “If he exceeded the stipulated condition, then he is liable. If he entered a valley and did not secure it, then he is liable. And if it fell into a well, then he is liable, because he did not take sufficient precaution regarding it.”

key_terms.الشَّرْطَ: the agreed stipulation or contractual condition
key_terms.يَسْتَوْثِقْ: take proper precaution or ensure safekeeping

ai.seo_question: When is a person liable if a rented animal is lost?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on liability for a rented animal that is lost. It establishes that when the renter goes beyond the agreed condition or fails to safeguard the animal properly, he is financially responsible for the loss.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
regarding a man who rents an animal to travel to a specified location, but the animal is lost:
"If he exceeded the agreed conditions, he is liable. If he entered a valley and did not secure the animal properly, he is liable. And if it fell into a well, he is liable because he did not take proper precautions to safeguard it."
